title: Boss: The Greedy Client
story: The client hammers the server and ignores its limits. Servers say how long to wait in a Retry-After header.
goal: Fix wait_time(status, headers) so a 429 returns the seconds to wait, and other statuses return 0.
hints: Header names can arrive in any capitalisation, and the value is text.
Lower-case the keys, convert to int, and default to 1 second.
socratic: Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what was the bug, and how did you fix it?
